title: 第5章 落花河畔第6章 香囊的秘密
slug: 重生后为当他的皇后杀疯了
content_zh:
如果……时光流转，一切都能够从头开始的话……
寂寥的星空，会被时间和人们演绎出怎样的斑斓呢？
樱落记得，施法闭眼前，身边都是漫天星云，之后便什么也不晓得了。
当她再次有了意识的时候，悠悠转醒，身体四肢都有一些酸痛，头也疼痛欲裂。
她……这是逆天改命，重生成功了吗？
此刻绝不是在天玑皇宫！
而是一个鸟语花香的地方。
如果巫术没有施展成功，又怎么会来到这里？
樱落定了定神，环顾看着四周，多么熟悉又陌生的场景。
凭窗望去，外面樱花满地，堆叠了几层，空气中弥漫着带着露水的樱花气息，仿佛很远，又仿佛很近。远处的村庄透露着人间烟火气息，一切都是那么的安逸平静。
这里是她的故乡，一个美得像是人间天堂的地方——樱花镇。
明明是那么的熟悉，明明是那么的渴望，可一切真实发生时，她又觉得一切恍若一场梦。
樱落狠狠的掐了一把自己，两行热泪滚滚而下。
长生天不负她！她真的重生回来了！
樱落起身，走到铜镜面前，看着镜子里面的自己，俨然还是一副十几岁少女的模样。
少女容貌绝美，一双星眸闪烁着点点星光，带着几分清冷，细腻无暇的肌肤吹弹可破，端的是风华无双。墨发如流云般倾泻而下，散落腰际，带着几分清丽脱俗。
模样还是和前世一样，没有变化。
只是，眉心用樱花簪划破血祭的地方，多了一道红色的印记，似是樱花的形状。
但这并不能影响她的倾国之姿，反而多了几分妖冶。
头有点痛。

前世的一些记忆，樱落仿佛有点记不清了，在脑海里面模糊不已。
想要抓住过往的全部记忆，却头痛欲裂……
“呼……”
樱落轻轻的叹了口气。
能改命重生成功，已经是万分之一的幸运。
因为动用巫术而失去绝大部分记忆，也在意料之中。
不过，她还记得这里——樱花镇，是天玑国和开阳国的交界处。
只是不知道，现在是什么时候？
如果是在樱花镇，那么一定是在她进宫之前！
就是不知道现在有没有和皇上相遇，皇上如今又怎么样了？
樱落十分担心。
她迫不及待的想要和他重逢。
前世两个人的悲剧，绝对不能再重现！
“这一次，我不会再任人宰割，我——樱落，要主宰自己的命运，我就是自己的天命！”
正在樱落沉思的时候，一道苍老的声音传来。
“樱丫头！愣在那儿干什么？快到爷爷这儿来！”
樱落顺着那道声音去寻找他的主人，目光所到之处是一位白发苍苍的老人。
是胡爷爷！
樱落记得胡爷爷，就是面前的这个老人家。
樱落原本是一介孤女，她不知道自己的亲生父母是谁，只知道多年前，在樱花镇的落花河边，是胡爷爷，将她捡回家，一直抚养长大。

因为是在樱花镇捡的她，所以取名叫小樱。
还有花无忧也是，被花婆婆收养，他们从小一起在樱花镇长大，他一直是她最好的知己。
想到无忧哥哥，樱落唇角微微上扬。
content_en:
If... time goes by and everything can start from scratch...
How beautiful will the lonely starry sky be interpreted by time and people?
Ying Luo remembered that when she closed her eyes after casting the spell, she was surrounded by stars and clouds in the sky, and she didn't know anything after that.
When she regained consciousness, she woke up, her body and limbs were aching, and her head was in pain.
She...is changing her fate against the will of heaven, has she been reborn successfully?
We are definitely not in Tianji Palace at this moment!
But a place where birds are singing and flowers are fragrant.
If the witchcraft was not successfully performed, how could it come here?
Sakura calmed down and looked around, seeing such a familiar yet unfamiliar scene.
Looking out the window, cherry blossoms are all over the ground outside, stacked in several layers. The air is filled with the dewy scent of cherry blossoms, which seems far away and yet very close. The villages in the distance reveal the atmosphere of human fireworks, and everything is so peaceful and peaceful.
This is her hometown, a place as beautiful as paradise on earth - Sakura Town.
It was obviously so familiar and so longing, but when everything really happened, she felt that everything was just like a dream.
Yingluo pinched herself hard, and tears rolled down her cheeks.
God will live up to her! She is really reborn!
Yingluo stood up, walked to the bronze mirror, and looked at herself in the mirror. She still looked like a teenage girl.
The girl has an absolutely beautiful face, a pair of starry eyes twinkling with starlight, a bit cold, her delicate and flawless skin can be broken by a blow, and she is unparalleled in elegance. The ink hair poured down like flowing clouds and scattered around her waist, giving her a somewhat elegant and refined look.
The appearance is still the same as in the previous life, no change.
However, where the blood sacrifice was cut with a cherry blossom hairpin between the eyebrows, there was a red mark, which seemed to be in the shape of a cherry blossom.
But this does not affect her charming appearance, but makes her more coquettish.
My head hurts a little.
Yingluo seemed to be unable to remember some of the memories from her previous life, and they were blurred in her mind.
I want to capture all the memories of the past, but I have a splitting headache...
"Huh..."
Sakura sighed softly.
Being able to successfully change one's life and be reborn is already one in ten thousand lucky.
Losing most of his memory due to the use of witchcraft is also expected.
However, she still remembers this place - Sakura Town, which is the junction of Tianji Kingdom and Kaiyang Kingdom.
I just don’t know, when is it now?
If it was in Sakura Town, then it must be before she entered the palace!
I just don’t know if I have met the emperor now, and what is happening to the emperor now?
Yingluo was very worried.
She couldn't wait to see him again.
The tragedy of the two people in the previous life must never happen again!
"This time, I will not let others control me again. I, Yingluo, will control my own destiny. I am my destiny!"
While Yingluo was deep in thought, an old voice came.
"Girl Sakura! What are you doing standing there? Come to grandpa quickly!"
Yingluo followed the voice to find his master, and wherever he looked, he saw a white-haired old man.
It's Grandpa Hu!
Yingluo remembered Grandpa Hu, the old man in front of her.
Yingluo was originally an orphan. She didn't know who her biological parents were. She only knew that it was Grandpa Hu who picked her up and raised her many years ago by the Luohua River in Sakura Town.
Because I picked her up in Sakura Town, I named her Sakura.
There is also Hua Wuyou, who was adopted by Granny Hua. They grew up together in Sakura Town, and he has always been her best confidant.
Thinking of brother Wuyou, the corners of Yingluo's lips rose slightly.
